description: JavaScript code for Gantt chart functionality in a project management module, including chart generation, task editing, link drawing, and UI interactions.

classes.name: HLine
classes.description: Represents a horizontal line used in link drawing between tasks.

classes.name: VLine
classes.description: Represents a vertical line used in link drawing between tasks.

methods.name: drawlink
methods.description: Draws a dependency link between two task elements based on the specified type ('SS' or 'FS').

methods.name: buildRect
methods.description: Extracts position, width, and height of a DOM element into a rectangle object.

methods.name: drawStartToEnd
methods.description: Draws a start-to-end dependency arrow between two task rectangles.

methods.name: drawStartToStart
methods.description: Draws a start-to-start dependency arrow between two task rectangles.

methods.name: gen_chart
methods.description: Generates or refreshes the Gantt chart via AJAX call.

methods.name: animate_percentages
methods.description: Animates the percentage completion bars on the Gantt chart.

methods.name: remove_button
methods.description: Initializes remove buttons for tasks, with confirmation dialogs.

methods.name: rows_sortable
methods.description: Enables drag-and-drop sorting of task rows and updates order via AJAX.

methods.name: get_predecessors
methods.description: Fetches list of predecessor tasks via AJAX for task linking.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Displays a loading overlay during AJAX operations.

methods.name: add_arrows
methods.description: Adds visual arrows between linked tasks.

methods.name: edit_task
methods.description: Populates and displays task editing dialog, then updates task via AJAX.
